20-F

Annual report or registration statement – This filing includes audited financial statements of the foreign private issuer and a discussion of the company’s financial results.
answer: When researching a foreign private issuer in EDGAR, look for forms that may differ from those filed by U.S. public companies. Form 20-F can be an annual report or a registration statement; its cover-page checkbox indicates which purpose applies. It includes audited financial statements and a discussion of the company’s financial results. Form 6-K is used for certain reports, including press releases and communications to security holders. Form F-1 may be used to register a securities offering.
